messages:
Anya (growth): Quick idea — the pricing calculator is surfacing odd totals for hybrid deployments (Hosted + Dedicated combos) and CS flagged a few inbound leads where estimate > $5k/mo but the CTA still shows self-serve. Can we define edge-case behavior + FAQ copy and route >$5k leads to the high-touch flow?
Sam (pm): Do we have specific examples? Is it a rounding/assumption bug or the UX that confuses them?
Anya (growth): Example from a thread: CPU-heavy + dedicated burst + private networking pushes estimate up. The calc currently assumes static per-GPU pricing and doesn't add network/proxy line items. Leads expect an invoice-like breakdown.
Diego (design): UI-wise we could surface a small breakdown section: "Compute / Networking / Support / Extras" and collapse advanced line items by default. Also a CTA switch once estimate > threshold — two variants: "Talk to sales" vs "Get detailed quote".
Maya (ops): If we route higher-dollar estimates to Sales/CS, we need an event hook and a flag we can use to backfill and avoid double-notifications. Also can we gate the routing behind an experiment flag?
Tom (sales): +1 to routing. For anything > $5k/mo please create a lead in Salesforce, assign to AE queue. We also want the CTA copy to ask a single clarifying question (e.g., "Company size / monthly tokens") before creating the lead so AEs aren't surprised.
Priya (content): I sketched FAQ copy options: short and long. Short: "Why is my estimate higher than expected?" -> "Estimates include reserved capacity and network egress. For custom workloads, request a quote." Long: include example breakdown and a link to a sample invoice. Happy to post variants.
Alex (eng): Two engineering asks: 1) precise telemetry event: calculator_result with fields (total_usd, components[], routing_flag). 2) Fallback UI for "calculation failed" where we don't show a bogus number — show "Contact us for a custom quote". Implementation should be trivial but need analytics schema.
Anya (growth): Good. Also let's avoid confusing tier naming in the calc UI. We had feedback that "Starter / Standard / Enterprise" didn't map cleanly to Dedicated vs Hosted. Maybe show "Hosted (pay-as-you-go) / Dedicated (reserved) / Private (VPC/on-prem)" next to each option.
Diego (design): Agreed — make the deployment mode explicit. Do we want to AB test full names vs short labels?
Sam (pm): Yes AB test. Variant A: full names + tooltip. Variant B: short labels + inline help link. Run for 4 weeks and then evaluate lift on conversions and demo bookings.
Maya (ops): I'll provision a feature flag for the AB test and add a sampling rule. We'll also pipe calculator_result to BigQuery with a field is_test_variant.
Tom (sales): For the lead routing flow: prefer "schedule demo" variant for >$5k, but if they pick "Get detailed quote" send to an intake form that collects expected token volumes and compliance needs.
Priya (content): I'll draft the FAQ + microcopy for the calc, plus two CTA variants. Quick draft will be in the #marketing-assets doc by tomorrow.
Alex (eng): Heads-up — we need error messaging for corner-case inputs (e.g., negative numbers, extremely high concurrent sessions). I'll add validation and a small client-side guard: `if (!Number.isFinite(q)) return 'Contact us for custom pricing'`.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch/pricing-calc-edgecases — CI checks passed 
Anya (growth): Action items: Priya drafts copy (due EOD tomorrow), Diego provides updated mock (48h), Alex hooks telemetry + fallback (sprint slot), Maya sets flag & BigQuery sync, Tom gets intake form spec. We'll reconvene Fri to confirm rollout window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
